title: How to Buy a Car Without Interest (Ijara Explained) #ijara #islamicfinance
description:
You paid $39,000 for a $30,000 car — and the extra $9,000 never touched the car. It was rent on money. Ijara flips the contract: the financier buys the car, owns it, carries the risk, and rents you the car — not the money. Every payment moves it closer to your name. The 1,400-year-old halal fix for car finance.

Part 13 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
